name: Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width, the kettlebell on the floor a foot in front of you.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the handle with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward hard, squeezing the glutes, so the bell swings up to about chest height with straight arms.
Let it fall back between your legs, hinging at the hips again rather than squatting, and go straight into the next rep.
